app.name: Boltget
sidebar.label: Library
empty.title: Paste a link or drop one here.
error.window: The window could not be updated. Restart Boltget if it looks wrong.
engine.locked: A download running in the Boltget command line is using your downloads. They appear here when it finishes.
engine.failed: Boltget could not open your downloads.
error.engine_unavailable: Your downloads are not open yet.
error.no_data_dir: Boltget could not find a folder to keep your downloads list in.
error.no_download_folder: Your Downloads folder could not be found. Choose a folder.
error.invalid_file_name: Type a file name without a folder in it.
error.invalid_checksum: That checksum is not valid. Use sha256:, sha512:, sha1: or md5: followed by the hex digest.
error.invalid_url: That link is not valid. Boltget downloads http and https links.
error.http.unauthorized: The server asks for a sign-in.
error.http.forbidden: The server refused access to this file.
error.http.not_found: The file is not on the server anymore.
error.http.proxy_auth: The proxy asks for a sign-in.
error.http.gone: The file has been removed from the server.
error.http.too_many_requests: The server is limiting requests. Boltget will try again.
error.http.server_error: The server had a problem. Boltget will try again.
error.http.status: The server answered with an error.
error.tls: The server's security certificate could not be verified.
error.protocol: The server sent a response Boltget could not read.
error.too_many_redirects: The link redirects too many times.
error.insecure_redirect: The link redirects from a secure address to an insecure one.
error.resource_changed: The file changed on the server. Start it again to get the new version.
error.range_unsupported: The server cannot continue this download where it stopped.
error.disk: The file could not be written.
error.disk_full: There is not enough space on the disk.
error.file_too_large_for_fs: The file is too large for this drive's file system.
error.database_locked: Another Boltget is using your downloads.
error.database: Your downloads list could not be read or saved.
error.unknown_download: That download is no longer in the list.
error.invalid_state: That cannot be done to this download right now.
error.partial_missing: The partly downloaded file is missing. Start the download again.
error.checksum_mismatch: The file does not match its checksum.
error.link_expired: The link has expired. Give it a new link to continue.
error.refresh_rejected: The new link points to a different file.

add.title: Add download
add.link.placeholder: Paste a link, or several, one per line
add.invalid: Paste an http or https link.
add.name: File name
add.folder.new: The folder is created when the download starts.
add.warn.web_page: This link returns a web page, not a file. It may need a sign-in.
add.warn.space: Not enough space on this drive: {free} free.
add.warn.renamed: {name} already exists there, so this one is saved as {saved}.
add.warn.listed: This link is already in your list.
add.error.unreachable: Boltget could not reach the server. Check the link and your connection.
add.error.auth: The server asks for a sign-in before it sends this file.
add.problem.connections: Use a number from 1 to 32, or leave it on Auto.
add.problem.limit: Type a speed in MiB/s, such as 2.5.
add.problem.checksum: Use sha256:, sha512:, sha1: or md5: followed by the hex digest.
add.problem.name: Type a file name.
add.problem.name_folder: Type a file name without a folder in it.

notify.background.title: Boltget is still running
notify.background: Downloads go on in the background. Quit from the tray icon.
settings.title: Settings
settings.theme.description: Follow Windows, or always use light or dark.
settings.autostart.description: Boltget starts in the tray when you sign in, so unfinished downloads continue.
settings.tray: Keep running when the window closes
settings.tray.description: Downloads go on in the background and Boltget stays in the tray. When this is off, closing the window quits.
settings.notifications.description: Say when downloads finish or need attention while Boltget is in the background.
settings.clipboard.description: When you copy a link to a file in another app, Boltget offers to download it. The clipboard is read only while this is on.
settings.folder.description: Where downloads go unless their category has a folder of its own.
settings.categories.description: A file’s type decides its category, and a category can keep its files in a folder of its own.
settings.category.extensions.label: {category} file types
settings.category.extensions.hint: Extensions separated by spaces, such as mp4 mkv
settings.category.other: Every file whose type is in no other category.
settings.category.folder.label: {category} folder: {folder}
settings.connections.description: Boltget adds connections while they make a download faster, up to this many. Applies to downloads that start or resume.
settings.limit.description: Shared by all downloads, and applied at once. Leave empty for no limit.
settings.limit.input: Speed limit in MiB per second
settings.proxy.description: How downloads reach the internet. Applies to downloads that start or resume.
settings.proxy.system.none: Windows uses no proxy, so downloads connect directly.
settings.proxy.system.script: Windows also uses a setup script (PAC), which Boltget does not run yet.
settings.proxy.url.description: host:port, with http://, https:// or socks5:// in front for other kinds.
settings.proxy.bypass.description: Addresses separated by semicolons, such as *.corp.example; 10.*
settings.shortcuts.description: The keys that work in the main window. Every action is also in the command palette.
settings.about.license: Boltget is open source under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later.
settings.about.trust: No ads, no tracking, no bundled offers.
settings.problem.limit: Type a speed in MiB/s, such as 2.5, or leave it empty.
settings.problem.folder_relative: Use a full path, such as D:\Downloads.
settings.problem.folder_file: That is a file, not a folder.
settings.problem.extension: Use extensions made of letters and digits, such as mp4.
settings.problem.extensions_many: That is too many file types for one category.
settings.problem.extension_taken: One of these file types is already in another category.
settings.problem.proxy: That is not a proxy address. Use host:port, with http://, https:// or socks5:// in front for other kinds.
settings.problem.proxy_credentials: Boltget does not keep proxy passwords yet. Remove the user name and password.
settings.problem.autostart: Windows did not let Boltget change this. Try again.
